name: esport-arena-x
description: E-Sport Tournament Arena X — secure Firebase Realtime Database + Vercel app. Zero secrets in repo.

scripts.build: node -e "for (const f of ['api/command.js','api/config.js','api/health.js','api/runtime.js','api/_admin.js','assets/js/boot.js','assets/js/user-app.js','assets/js/admin-app.js']) { require('child_process').execSync('node --check '+f, {stdio:'inherit'}); } console.log('build: syntax OK');"
